enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Close eyes. Sleep. Turn to side. Adjust pillow. Sleep.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing, and getting dressed
enriched_activities.desc: Open eyes. Sit up in bed. Swing legs out of bed. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Spit. Rinse mouth. Put down toothbrush. Wash face. Pick up towel. Dry face. Put down towel. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Remove pajamas. Put on underwear. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks.

Open refrigerator. Take out milk. Take out eggs. Take out bread. Close refrigerator. Place bread in toaster. Press toaster lever. Crack eggs into bowl. Whisk eggs. Turn on induction cooker. Place pan on cooker. Pour oil into pan. Pour eggs into pan. Stir eggs. Turn off induction cooker. Take toast from toaster. Put eggs on plate. Put toast on plate. Sit at table. Eat breakfast. Drink milk.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting ready and packing for work
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open wardrobe. Pick out work clothes. Put on work clothes. Open drawer. Take out socks. Put on socks. Take out shoes. Put on shoes. Open backpack. Put in laptop. Put in notebook. Put in pen. Put in stethoscope. Put in water bottle. Zip backpack. Pick up backpack. Walk out of bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting to hospital (using public transport, no EV needed)
enriched_activities.desc: Check phone for bus schedule. Put phone in pocket. Walk to bus stop. Stand at bus stop. Bus arrives. Step onto bus. Tap transit card. Find seat. Sit down. Hold handrail. Look out window. Get off bus. Walk to hospital.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a physiotherapist at the hospital
enriched_activities.desc: Arrive at hospital. Walk to locker room. Change into uniform. Put on name badge. Walk to therapy gym. Greet colleagues. Review patient schedule. Call first patient. Assist patient with exercises. Demonstrate exercises. Adjust equipment. Document patient progress. Call next patient. Assist patient with mobility training. Teach patient to use walker. Document notes. Take a short break. Drink water.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a lunch break at the hospital
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to cafeteria. Pick up tray. Choose food. Pay for food. Carry tray to table. Sit down. Eat food. Drink water. Wipe mouth with napkin. Throw away trash. Return tray. Walk back to department. Chat with colleague.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a physiotherapist at the hospital
enriched_activities.desc: Return to therapy gym. Check patient list. Call patient. Assist patient with exercise. Demonstrate exercise. Monitor patient. Adjust equipment. Document progress. Attend team meeting. Discuss patient cases. Return to gym. Treat patient. Teach patient home exercises. Document notes. Clean equipment.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting home from hospital (using public transport, no EV needed)
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bus stop. Check bus schedule on phone. Put phone in pocket. Wait for bus. Bus arrives. Step onto bus. Tap transit card. Find seat. Sit down. Hold handrail. Look out window. Get off bus. Walk home.

Enter bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Remove work clothes. Turn on shower. Adjust temperature. Step into shower. Wash body. Shampoo hair. Rinse hair. Turn off shower. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Put on clean clothes. Turn off light.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing, eating, and cleaning up dinner
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables. Take out meat. Close refrigerator. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Turn on induction cooker. Place pan on cooker. Pour oil. Add meat. Stir meat. Add vegetables. Stir vegetables. Turn off cooker. Put food on plate. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water. Clear table. Wash dishes. Put dishes in dishwasher. Wipe counter.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing in the living room, watching TV or reading
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channels. Watch TV. Pick up book. Read book. Turn page. Put down book. Pick up phone. Check messages. Reply to message. Put down phone. Pick up remote. Turn off TV.

enriched_activities.activity: Winding down and preparing for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Use toilet. Flush toilet. Wash hands. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Spit. Rinse mouth. Wash face. Dry face. Turn off light. Walk to bedroom.
Lie down on bed. Pull blanket up. Close eyes. Sleep.
